context: Hua98, transition to the Tor base-change problem, p. 37 and later lemma pp. 38–39 (scans 038–040).
sentences: The question receives a sufficient answer in the following lemma: flatness of the relative scheme and the input modules over the base, together with flatness of the relevant output Tor groups, makes the edge comparisons isomorphisms in the stated range.
The input-module assumption is present in the frozen later lemma, and B19 shows why output flatness alone cannot replace it.

This links the question to the subsequent development while distinguishing the valid criterion from the resolution-ring defect in its written proof; the coefficient-ring ambiguity in the first formulation remains R07.
